Mayank Khandelwal

PMP® Certified Project Manager | Technical Leadership | eCommerce & FinTech

Email: imayank.khandelwal@gmail.com Phone: +91-8017482686 LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/mayank-khandelwal Location: Hyderabad, India

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

PMP-certified Project Manager with a unique blend of technical expertise and strategic project leadership. 7+ years delivering eCommerce and FinTech solutions, progressing from a hands-on developer to managing $500K+ portfolios across 25 accounts. Strong foundation in Java, Spring Boot, AWS/GCP cloud architectures, and microservices enables effective stakeholder communication and swift technical decision-making. Currently leading 28+ professionals across 4 Agile teams with 98% on-time delivery and 95% client satisfaction. Skilled in risk mitigation, financial forecasting, and process improvement, achieving 20–30% faster delivery through data-driven methodologies.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Project & Portfolio Management

• • •

Methodologies: Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, SDLC Management. Planning & Execution: SOW Development, Resource Allocation, Budget Control, Sprint Planning, Financial Forecasting. Risk & Governance: Risk Mitigation, Change Management, SLA Management, Project Governance. Strategic Leadership: Stakeholder Engagement, Account Management, Team Leadership, Decision-Making.

Technical Expertise

• •

Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Hibernate, Struts, REST APIs, Python. Frontend: React.js, Vue.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, jQuery. Database & DevOps: SQL, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD Pipelines, AWS, GCP.

Tools & Platforms

• •

Management: JIRA, Confluence, MS Project, Slack, Microsoft Teams. Development: GitHub, GitLab, SonarQube, Postman, VS Code, Eclipse. Business: Salesforce CRM, Freshdesk, Microsoft Excel (Advanced), Smart Sheets.

EXPERIENCE

Unilog Content Solutions

Associate Technical Project Manager May 2025 – Present



•

Manage a $500K+ portfolio for 25 client accounts, utilizing financial forecasting to maintain zero budget overruns and a 95% NPS score. Transformed client relationships into strategic partnerships, transparent project governance. Drive cross-functional alignment by translating complex technical constraints into business value for C-suite stakeholders. Championed the use of automated JIRA dashboards and Excel trackers to increase delivery visibility by 40%, optimizing resource utilization across four Agile teams.

leading to multiple contract renewals and the approval of additional billable SOWs through

Technical Project Lead

Sep 2023 – May 2025

• • •

Spearheaded end-to-end delivery for North American eCommerce businesses, managing portfolios worth $300K+ with 98% on-time delivery. Identified upsell opportunities during technical discovery phases, successfully converting project gaps into new billable SOWs. Established a standardized code review process using SonarQube, reducing production bugs by 60% and shortening deployment cycles. Orchestrated the transition of SMB clients to AWS and GCP cloud architectures, improving application performance and client trust.

Software Development Engineer 2 Dec 2022 – Sep 2023

• •

Engineered scalable microservices and REST APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and Hibernate for high-traffic eCommerce applications. Developed responsive, user-centric front-end components using JavaScript and Vue.js, improving engagement across client platforms. Mentored junior developers on debugging efficiency and enforced high coding standards through SonarLint and comprehensive documentation.

HighRadius Technologies

Associate Software Engineer II

Jul 2021 – Dec 2022

• •

Developed an AI-powered receivables platform using a full-stack Java/Ext.js architecture, supporting over 50 enterprise-level clients. Reduced application response time by optimizing complex SQL queries and database indexing, cutting execution time by 19%. Integrated Machine Learning models into production pipelines in collaboration with data science teams to automate credit risk assessments.

Associate Software Engineer I

Sep 2020 – Jul 2021

• •

Collaborated with data science teams to integrate Machine Learning models into the production pipeline, reducing deployment time from days to hours. Developed MLOps platform components using Java to enable real-time model predictions for credit risk assessment. Designed intuitive UI components using JavaScript and ExtJS, increasing platform usability by 30% based on user feedback.

Frontend Developer

May 2019 – Aug 2020

• •

Developed autonomous receivables applications using React.js for two major financial services clients. Created interactive dashboards and data visualizations using JavaScript, CSS3, and HTML5, resulting in a 25% increase in user engagement. Ensured cross-browser compatibility and optimized front-end performance for complex financial data sets.

CERTIFICATIONS

AI in Agile Delivery | PMI, 2026 • Applied Data Science Specialization | Coursera, 2022 • Project Management Professional (PMP) | PMI, 2025 • Data Science with Python Track | Data Camp, 2019 • Data Landscape of GenAI for PMs | PMI, 2025

ACHIEVEMENTS

Customer Appreciation Award, Portfolio Excellence | Unilog, Jan 2026 • Star Employee of the Quarter | Unilog, 2023 • Outstanding Multi-Project Delivery Award | Unilog, 2025 • 2x Highflyer Awards | HighRadius, 2021, 2022

EDUCATION

BTech in Computer Science and Systems Engineering | KIIT University | 2020 | CGPA: 8.5.

• • •
